review.summary: Phoenix is currently in a research-only status with significant gaps in its architecture and controls. The lack of settled outcomes and verified observations, along with the inability to connect all storage backends, indicates that it is not ready for production. The existing controls do not sufficiently mitigate the identified risks.
top_technical_reasons: No settled 24-month outcomes to validate performance.
No verified BCS observations to support claims.
Storage backends not all connected, limiting data integrity.
Fact-check stage is injectable but not yet canonical, raising concerns about reliability.
Orchestrator not yet wired into Streamlit runtime, affecting operational readiness.
review.candidate_safety: The current safety measures are insufficient due to the identified gaps and the research-only status of Phoenix.
